fusions.name: Running Takeoff
fusions.desc: Flaps up and drops onto the target for 26 damage as a critical hit, up to 1.5 times that from 7 tiles away. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Gust
fusions.desc: Beats a gust from your wings through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Your movement speed rises by 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fence Hop
fusions.desc: Flutters up and over to a point up to 5 tiles away, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow-Boned Stride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and you carry 8% wind resistance.
